ipecac: n. a medicinal drug used to evoke vomiting (especially in cases of drug overdose or poisoning)
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">ipecac，ipecacuanha 的縮略，源自葡萄牙語，源自圖皮語 ipekaaguéne</dd></dl>
ipo: abbr. 首次公開募股（Initial Public Offerings）；初次公開發行（Initial Public Offering）
n a corporation's first offer to sell stock to the public
ipod: n. 蘋果公司音樂播放器
n. (trademark) a pocket-sized device used to play music files
iproniazid: n. [藥]異煙醯異丙肼(原為抗結核藥, 現用作治療精神抑鬱症)
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">由 isoniazid（異煙肼）和 propyl（丙基）混合而成</dd></dl>
ipsilateral: a. on or relating to the same side (of the body)
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">國際科學詞彙：ipsi-、ipse-、ipso-（源自拉丁語 ipse）＋lateral</dd></dl>
